headlines.title: 3 killed, including gunman, in Minneapolis mass shooting
headlines.description: 3 people were killed, and several others injured, after a gunman opened fire in a Minneapolis high-rise building. 3 police officers were injured in the shooting, including one who was in surgery as of Wednesday night. The shooter was found dead by police officers. NBC News' Steve Patterson reports.

headlines.title: Couple arrested after 5-year-old nonverbal daughter is found dead in South Carolina waters
headlines.description: John Herb Hayes III, 70, and Geordyn Nichole Hayes, 31, were charged with unlawfully placing a child at risk or willfully abandoning a child.

headlines.title: US and Iran Trade New Strikes as the War Enters its 7th Month
headlines.description: The United States and Iran are exchanging new attacks across the Middle East, following days of renewed threats from both sides. CENTCOM says the U.S. struck Iranian air defense sites, radar systems and other military targets in response to Iran’s recent attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: USS Abraham Lincoln ends record stretch at sea
headlines.description: The USS Abraham Lincoln ended a record stretch at sea, making its first port call in nine months. It comes amid concerns about living conditions aboard. NBC News’ Courtney Kube reports.

headlines.title: Inside a Ukrainian maternity ward as Russian strikes intensify
headlines.description: As Russia ramps up strikes on Ukrainian cities, one underground maternity ward is allowing women to deliver babies safely amid a brutal war. NBC News' Richard Engel went inside.

headlines.title: Colin Kaepernick believes Jay-Z has a ‘guilty conscience’ over deals with NFL and Target
headlines.description: Kaepernick made the comments as part of an extensive interview with NBC News ahead of the release of his memoir, “The Perilous Fight.”

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy jury deadlocked again as judge orders jurors to keep deliberating
headlines.description: The judge in Lindsay Clancy’s murder trial delivered a Tuey-Rodriguez instruction to the jury after jurors told him for a second time that they could not reach a unanimous verdict. NBC News’ Emilie Ikeda reports.

headlines.title: Customers are losing their appetites over disturbing AI-generated menus
headlines.description: AI “slop” is increasingly on offer at brick-and-mortar establishments.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Ukrainian LSU women’s basketball player leaves team over signing of Russian recruit
headlines.description: Kate Koval left the women’s basketball program “to remain true to myself, my values and my country.”

headlines.title: Trump says he’ll campaign for Republicans in 35 races ahead of the midterms
headlines.description: The president said he’ll travel to help out GOP candidates in competitive midterm contests, including the Senate races in Alaska and Texas.
